mapper.select:
SELECT ii.*, u.user_name, u.avatar FROM invoice ii LEFT JOIN tb_user u ON ii.user_id = u.user_id
and ii.user_id = #{param.userId}
and u.user_name like concat('%', #{param.userName} ,'%')
and ii.type = #{param.type}
and ii.credit_code like concat('%', #{param.creditCode} ,'%')
and ii.address like concat('%', #{param.address} ,'%')
and ii.phone like concat('%', #{param.phone} ,'%')
and ii.open_bank like concat('%', #{param.openBank} ,'%')
and ii.bank_number like concat('%', #{param.bankNumber} ,'%')
and ii.receive_email like concat('%', #{param.receiveEmail} ,'%')
and ii.receive_phone like concat('%', #{param.receivePhone} ,'%')
ORDER BY ii.create_time DESC
